title: Quarrystone opens its roadmap
text:
Quarrystone Labs opened its platform team roadmap to customers this month, a move its co-founder Runa Okonkwo described as the least surprising thing the company could do given how it already works.

The roadmap is a public page with three columns and no dates. Okonkwo says dates are the part customers actually want and the part the team is least able to promise honestly, so the columns read now, next and not yet.

Okonkwo has spent most of the last four years on developer-tools go-to-market, and the roadmap is of a piece with that: the argument is that a company selling to engineers is selling to people who will read whatever you publish and notice what you did not.

The page went up on 11 February 2026 and has already collected a hundred comments.
